name: Skill Factory
description: A skills-only OpenClaw plugin that bundles skill-generator, skill-assessor and skill-splitter, plus a screenshot-input bridge and an end-to-end orchestrator, to continuously produce, assess, split and govern new Agent Skills.

registryPath.description: Path to the governance registry JSON. Only records verified skill versions; never affects runtime eligibility.

stagingDir.description: Directory where generated skill candidates are staged before authorized install.

assessorPassScore.description: Minimum skill-assessor score (0-100) required before a candidate may be installed.
